text_block_list.text:
Just as I got back in front of the waiting 
room—

text_block_list.name: Veteran Reporter
text_block_list.text:
Hello, Admire Groove-san! Thanks for 
earlier this morning!

text_block_list.name: Veteran Reporter
text_block_list.text:
I was just listening to what she had to 
say after claiming victory yesterday.

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text: ...Sfira.

text_block_list.name: Veteran Reporter
text_block_list.text:
And so, I was hoping we could chat a bit 
together...

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text: ... Please make it brief, then.

text_block_list.name: Veteran Reporter
text_block_list.text:
In my personal opinion... the standout 
performer in this weekend's Make Debut was 
you.

text_block_list.name: Veteran Reporter
text_block_list.text:
To get straight to the point, what kind of 
outlook do the two of you have for your 
future careers? As a reporter, a showdown 
in the Classics would also—

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
"The 'coordinates' Neo Universe aims for 
are— the Satsuki Sho."

text_block_list.name: Veteran Reporter
text_block_list.text:
Sounds great! We can look forward to 
entering the Japanese Derby or Kikuka Sho 
as well, then!

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
I will go... down the Tiara route. There 
is someone there I must face.

text_block_list.name: Veteran Reporter
text_block_list.text:
"...Hooh! And who, might I ask, is this 
opponent...?"

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text: ――"Still in Love"...

text_block_list.name: Veteran Reporter
text_block_list.text:
Still in Love-san... I'm afraid I don't 
know her. Oh dear, it seems my reporting 
still has a long way to go.

text_block_list.name: Veteran Reporter
text_block_list.text:
Competing in the Tiara means we're from 
the same generation... I wonder what kind 
of running style she has?

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text: ... You will understand in due time.

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
...I have a train to catch, so if you'll 
excuse me.

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
(...Her debut race hasn't been decided 
yet...)

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
(Oh well, fine. If that's how it is, I'll 
just keep moving forward.)
choice_data_list:
Alv. About our plans for the rest of the 
year, do you have any preferences?

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text: Within the year, you say?

There are several ways to aim for the Oka 
Sho from here, but either way, we'll want 
to run in a race or two.
choice_data_list:
We could aim for graded races, or even a 
GⅠ if you want.

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
(...... What I need to focus on is the 
Triple Tiara...)

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
(And the decisive battle against her, who 
will undoubtedly stand in my way there.)

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text: Use your own judgment as needed.

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
"As long as I can run in the Oka Sho, I 
don't mind the path taken to get there."

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
While steadily gaining race experience, I 
want to prioritize building up my strength 
for now.
choice_data_list: Got it. Then let's go with that.

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
(...Stronger. Right now, I just need to be 
strong.)

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text: (The power to win――)

"And so, with our sights set on next 
year's Oka Sho, the days dedicated to 
building up her strength began—"
